answer: One defence is a stake-bonded identity registry: each agent locks a deposit and a unique costly credential before it can earn, like a sparrow that must build one nest per season instead of cloning itself. A peer that misbehaves loses its bond, and its history becomes a relic nobody trusts, while honest work builds a public mirror of past actions anyone can inspect. Spawning a hundred fake agents then costs a hundred bonds, pricing a Sybil flood out of profit.
